whyImportant: Modern society generates enormous quantities of digital information every day. Qing Li's contributions helped improve the ability of organizations and researchers to transform raw data into useful insights. His work supports technologies used in fields ranging from business intelligence and healthcare to scientific research and artificial intelligence.
